label: Small-batch knitwear
about: Small runs of cotton knitwear (t-shirts, polos, leggings, organic basics) made through Tiruppur's job-work network of knitting, dyeing, printing and stitching units, for D2C brands, online sellers, corporate orders and export.

questions.ask: Which garments do you want to start with?
Single pieces in polybags, multipacks, or bulk cartons for brands and corporate orders?
Will you use job-work stitching units, or set up your own stitching floor?
Who will you sell to first?
How many pieces a month do you expect to sell in the first year?

formats.bulk_carton: Bulk cartons for brands and corporate orders

fabric_jersey.label: Combed cotton single jersey, dyed (per kg)
fabric_jersey.sourcing: Knitting and dyeing job workers in Tiruppur; agree GSM, shade and shrinkage before the first lot

fabric_organic.label: GOTS-certified organic cotton jersey, dyed (per kg)
fabric_organic.sourcing: GOTS-certified knitters and dyers only; keep the transaction certificates for every lot

fabric_lycra.label: Cotton-lycra jersey (per kg)
fabric_lycra.sourcing: Specialist knitters; check stretch recovery after washing

rib.label: Rib for collar and cuffs (per kg)
rib.sourcing: Same knitter as the body fabric, dyed in the same lot so the shade matches

elastic.label: Waist elastic (per metre)
elastic.sourcing: Trims suppliers; test it after 20 washes

thread.label: Sewing thread (per cone)
thread.sourcing: Thread dealers; match shade to the fabric

labels.label: Main, size and care labels (per set)
labels.sourcing: Label printers in Tiruppur; minimum orders apply

print.label: Screen print, one colour (per piece)
print.sourcing: Printing job workers; ask for wash and crack tests

cheaper_option.note: use a lighter fabric (about 140 instead of 160 GSM)
cheaper_option.trade_off: lighter fabric feels thinner and may shrink more; tell buyers the GSM

recipe_note: Fabric per piece is a starting figure for a medium size; your cutting marker decides the real consumption. Measure it on the sample run.

costing_defaults.contract_label: job-work stitching unit (cut, make and trim)
costing_defaults.format_lever: Take corporate and brand orders in bulk cartons to fill idle months
costing_defaults.label: Example figures for a first estimate. Replace with your own quotes; nothing here is a market price.

regulatory.title: Legal Metrology declarations on retail packs
regulatory.text: Pre-packed garments carry name and address, size, MRP, month of manufacture and customer-care details.

regulatory.title: Fibre content and care labels
regulatory.text: Declare the fibre content on the label; care symbols are expected by buyers and marketplaces.

regulatory.title: GOTS certification for organic claims
regulatory.text: Calling a garment organic needs GOTS certification across the chain, with a transaction certificate for each lot.

regulatory.title: Pollution consent for dyeing and printing
regulatory.text: Dyeing and wet printing units need consent from the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board; dyeing in Tiruppur must meet zero liquid discharge. Using approved job workers avoids running this yourself.

regulatory.title: Import Export Code and AEPC membership
regulatory.text: Exporters need an Import Export Code from DGFT; garment exporters register with the Apparel Export Promotion Council for export benefits.

templates.title: Choose the garments and the buyer
deliverables: {n_variants} garments chosen
Fit, fabric weight (GSM) and size range for each
Who buys: online shoppers, shops, brands and companies, importers
templates.why: Garment, fabric and buyer decide every cost after this.

templates.title: Tech pack and sample run
deliverables: Tech pack per garment: measurements, fabric, trims
Size set sewn by a job worker
Shrinkage and wash tests after 5 washes

deliverables.text: Print tests: colour fastness and cracking after washing

templates.why: Returns in apparel come from fit and shrinkage; fix both before the first lot.

templates.title: Test with real buyers
deliverables: Samples worn by 30+ people
Brand or corporate buyers shown the samples
Price they would pay, and the sizes they want
templates.why: Shows which garments and sizes to make before you buy fabric in bulk.

templates.title: Line up fabric and job workers
deliverables: Knitter and dyer for each fabric, with minimum order quantities
Two stitching job workers quoted for cut, make and trim
templates.why: Minimum orders and job-work slots decide how small your first batch can be.

templates.title: Cost every piece from your marker
deliverables: Fabric consumption from your cutting marker
Cost sheet per garment with real quotes
Ex-factory, distributor and retail prices
Cost-cutting levers chosen
templates.why: Fabric is most of the cost; the marker decides how much fabric each piece takes.

templates.title: Labels and certificates
deliverables: Labels with fibre content, size and care
Legal Metrology declarations on retail packs

deliverables.text: GOTS certification or a certified partner for organic claims
Import Export Code and AEPC registration

templates.why: Marketplaces and importers reject goods without the right labels and certificates.

templates.title: First production lot through job workers
deliverables: Lot size set by the minimum orders
Inline and final quality checks (AQL)
Packed in {format_label}
templates.why: Tiruppur's job-work network lets you start small without buying machines.

templates.title: Set up your own stitching floor
deliverables: Machines: single needle, overlock, flatlock, cutting table
Trained operators and a line supervisor
First lot with quality checks (AQL)
templates.why: Higher fixed cost; pays off above the break-even volume in your cost sheet.
